name: Blue and John Crow Mountains
description: In southeastern Jamaica, the Blue and John Crow Mountains rise in rugged, densely forested ridges that once sheltered people escaping slavery, first Tainos and later the Maroons. They hid and resisted colonial rule along a network of trails and settlements now known as the Nanny Town Heritage Route. The cloud forests also shelter many plants found nowhere else, especially mosses, lichens and some flowering species.
